title: Jurnal Keluarga Sehat Sejahtera
scope:
The Journal of Healthy and Prosperous Families (JKSS) is an open-access journal dedicated to the advancement of knowledge in the fields of family welfare, family resource empowerment, and the dynamics of individual development within the domestic sphere. Our primary focus is to serve as a platform for multidisciplinary research that contributes to the creation of strong family resilience amid global social change.
Childcare Dynamics and Contemporary Parenting

Family Economic Resilience and Family Resource Management

Reproductive Health, Nutrition, and Family Mental Health

Family Law, Advocacy, and Domestic Protection

Social Pathology and Family Dysfunction Analysis

Contemporary Issues and Modern Family Lifestyle Trends

Public Policy and Family Welfare Empowerment Programs

Family Education and Child Development

Sports, Physical Activity, and Family Health

Family Tourism, Community-Based Tourism, and the Socioeconomic Impact of Tourism on Family Resilience

 
 
JKSS accepts articles in the form of field research results (qualitative and quantitative), in-depth case studies, and literature reviews that provide critical thinking and practical solutions to modern family problems.
